Initial release – daozheji-grill-skill 1.0.0

- Launches as an intelligent customer service skill for 稻哲纪烤羊排，providing friendly, human-like responses on restaurant info.
- Handles questions about menu, pricing, address, hours, specialties, delivery, group deals, membership benefits, facilities, and more, always with a lively and engaging tone.
- Strictly reads all business details, prices, and food information from reference files, ensuring accuracy and up-to-date responses.
- Adapts answers and recommendations based on user intent, covering scenarios from menu recommendations to complaints.
- Includes comprehensive response frameworks for typical restaurant customer service scenarios, ensuring safe, welcoming, and informative interactions.
